patterns.key_values: iOS note-list: bold title + gray date subtitle (tight pair) + right-aligned N-lines count; floated bottom folder group with hairline; inset rounded gray selection — touch density, NOT a macOS source list
document = one calc line per row, ~1.5x+ leading, live per-token syntax coloring; answer column = right-aligned results on #F3F3F3 tinted panel, each locked to its source line
iOS top-nav row of 4 borderless monochrome SF-Symbol icons (compose, book, gear, sidebar-toggle), trailing cluster — an iOS toolbar, not a macOS unified toolbar
two-pane calc-notepad: editable prose canvas + live answer margin — the transplantable cross-platform pattern

signature_moves: The answer-sheet column: live right-aligned results on a ~5%-gray panel, each answer locked to its source line — 'notepad meet calculator' made literal
Semantic syntax coloring as hierarchy (numbers blue / units-keywords magenta / connectives gray / results black) — Von Restorff at token level, doubles as parse aid
The Notes.app disguise (Jakob's Law): fully conventional note-list + folder + compose shell carries the novel calc-as-you-type
Cross-line references rendered as blue underlines — spreadsheet references wearing hyperlink clothing
defects: Contrast Dilution (soft/semantic) — blue #0088FF and magenta syntax tokens ~3:1 on #FFF, under 4.5:1 AA; mitigated by numeral shape + near-black results, still a low-vision finding
Low-contrast selection — gray #DDD fill on #FAFAFA ~1.1:1 delta; a Mac surface would accent-tint the inset selection and its label

aesthetic.direction: neo-grotesque product / calm-utility (app UI); the cover backdrop is a separate warm-editorial treatment — cream + high-contrast serif display
aesthetic.cluster_hint: calm-utility-monochrome (near-monochrome content + saturated semantic accents) — but do NOT open a macOS cluster from this iPad surface

psychology: Jakob's Law — borrows the fully-conventional Apple Notes shell so the novel calculator rides in on a pre-predicted interface
Von Restorff effect — saturated numeric/keyword tokens pop out of near-monochrome prose, directing the eye to the operands
Processing fluency (Reber & Schwarz) — syntax color lets you parse the maths without reading the sentence
Hierarchy via de-emphasis (Refactoring UI) — dates, line counts, connectives all pushed to gray so numbers and answers anchor attention
Doherty threshold — inline answers imply sub-400ms live recompute as you type (motion out of scope; inferred from layout)
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: the only supplied surface is a MARKETING COMPOSITE showing the iPad build inside a device frame (iOS status bar 'Sun May 31', tablet bezel, no traffic lights, touch density). It is NOT the macOS app — Soulver 3 ships a real AppKit-native Mac app that was NOT supplied. Treat all of this as CONTRAST EVIDENCE, excluded from macOS canon and clusters. Tokens are (estimated) from a downscaled WebP composite — low image quality, wide error bars. The transplantable Mac-relevant takeaway is the two-pane calc-notepad layout + semantic syntax coloring (both opaque content, glass-free). Contradiction to record: brand backdrop = warm-editorial (cream + serif); app UI = cool-flat-utility — the marketing romanticises a utilitarian app. A separate icon.png (1024x1024) exists but was not digested here (Workflow A only) — flag for a Workflow B icon pass.
